719-7507-7874-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
719-7507-7874-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Xenograft, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the The Immortal Weapons token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2790-2990.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 5.
Angel of Destiny does not have summoning sickness.
2790-2990.notablePrerequisites:
You control three other creatures that do not have summoning sickness.
Opponents cannot block flying creatures you control.
2790-2990.description:
Cast Sakashima's Will by paying its mana cost targeting Angel of Destiny, causing each other creature you control to become a copy of the chosen creature until end of turn.
Move to combat and declare all your Angels as attackers, sending at least one Angel at each opponent.
When first strike damage is dealt, each Angel of Destiny you control triggers for each creature that dealt damage.
Resolve each trigger, causing each opponent to gain life equal to X times the damage they took (where X is the number of Angels you control) and you to gain life equal to that combined total.
Repeat steps 4-5 for the normal damage step.
At the beginning of your end step, since your life total is at least 45, each Angel of Destiny you control triggers, causing the player it attacked to lose the game.

1753-2023-4518-6006.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

512-5475-7308.easyPrerequisites:
Mona Lisa and Forensic Researcher do not have summoning sickness.
Mona Lisa has power 2 or greater.
512-5475-7308.description:
Activate Mona Lisa by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Forensic Researcher and Mona Lisa, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-5475-7308.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Mona Lisa's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

1579-3899-6972--112.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Visionary Augmenter.
When Visionary Augmenter dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Visionary Augmenter enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.
1579-3899-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Visionary Augmenter's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

2595-5641-6566.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}, which enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Combine Guildmage.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Combine Guildmage.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Yuna triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

1308-4094-4826-7824-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Archelos.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

requires.n: Goblin, Orc or Army Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

997-5220-7729-7855--180.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the Goblin, Orc or Army
When the Goblin, Orc or Army dies, The Great Goblin's second ability and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the Goblin, Orc or Army onto the top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Great Goblin trigger, exiling the Goblin, Orc or Army from the top of your library with the ability to play it until the end of your next turn.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability
Cast the Goblin, Orc or Army from exile by paying its mana cost.
The Vision and Scarlet Witch triggers, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Repeat
997-5220-7729-7855--180.notes: The chosen Goblin, Orc or Army must be castable for {R}.

2457-4289-4359-7824.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

2457-2557-5794-7824.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating four 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping the four Insect tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

1580-4871-5256-6887.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and The Skullspore Nexus trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1477-4559-7306-7430.notablePrerequisites:
Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
You've had two creatures die under your control this turn.
1477-4559-7306-7430.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gorma.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, Gorma and The Ooze trigger.
Resolve The Ooze's trigger, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve Gorma's trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

240-997-5470-6633.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Brigid, Clachan's Heart // Brigid, Doun's Mind

1781-1978-7203.description:
Cause Brigid to become an artifact using Thran Forge.
Activate Brigid by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G} or {W}{W}{W}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Brigid.
Repeat from step 2.

1292-3117-5078-5465.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and putting Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Jace's Erasure triggers, causing you to mill Sensei's Divining Top.
When Sensei's Divining Top is milled, Grolnok triggers, exiling Sensei's Divining Top with a croak counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat.

5526-5702-6441.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
5526-5702-6441.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Kamahl's Will
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

2919-3188-3490-5231.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2919-3188-3490-5231.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Archangel of Thune trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

1379-1651-5640-6218.description:
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping it and Pheres-Band Tromper, targeting Pheres-Band Tromper.
Ertha Jo triggers, copying Clock of Omens' ability, targeting Clock of Omens.
Resolve both Clock of Omens  abilities, untapping it and Pheres-Band Tromper.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

145-478-6871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three enchantments.
145-478-6871.description:
Activate Serra's Sanctum by tapping it, adding {W} for each enchantment you control.
Activate Candelabra of Tawnos by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Serra's Sanctum and Candelabra of Tawnos as it is a land due to Toph.
Repeat.

2034-3490-4616-6783.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
2034-3490-4616-6783.description:
Activate Junk Golem by paying {1} and discarding a card, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
When the Servo dies, Moldervine Reclamation triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
Repeat.

944-4050-4484-5643.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
944-4050-4484-5643.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
944-4050-4484-5643.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

4053-4927-5499--6.notablePrerequisites: The creature with undying does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
4053-4927-5499--6.description:
Activate the creature with undying by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
When the creature dies, Solemnity triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {3}, attaching it to the undying creature.
Repeat.

1846-2719-3546-3783-4300.notablePrerequisites: You control an Island that enters the battlefield untapped.
1846-2719-3546-3783-4300.description:
Cast High Tide by paying {U}.
Activate an Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
High Tide triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Meloku by paying {1} and returning the tapped Island from the battlefield to your hand, creating a 1/1 Illusion creature token.
Activate High Market's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing the Illusion.
When the Illusion dies, Sakashima of a Thousand Faces and Minn's second abilities trigger.
Holding priority, activate Meloku by paying {1} and returning High Market from the battlefield to your hand, creating a 1/1 Illusion creature token.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces and Minn triggers, putting an Island and High Market from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1379-1543-3666-4312.notablePrerequisites:
Vorel of the Hull Clade does not have summoning sickness.
Nissa has at least 12 loyalty counters on it.
1379-1543-3666-4312.description:
Activate Vorel of the Hull Clade by paying {G}{U} and tapping it, doubling the number of counters on Nissa.
Activate Nissa by removing twelve loyalty counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

586-4050-4316-5220.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Priest of Gix, adding {B}.
When Priest of Gix dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Priest of Gix on top of your library from your graveyard.
Cast Priest of Gix from the top of your library by paying {2}{B}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

575-3366-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Wall of Deceit, adding {U}.
When Wall of Deceit dies, Yedora triggers, returning Wall of Deceit from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Activate Wall of Deceit by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Wall of Deceit's morph ability by paying {U}, turning it face up.
Repeat.

2034-3996-4055.notablePrerequisites: Twilight Drover has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
2034-3996-4055.description:
Activate Twilight Drover by paying {2}{W} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Spirit tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Spirits die, Twilight Drover triggers twice, putting two +1/+1 counters on Twilight Drover.
Activate Energy Refractor by paying {2}, adding {W}.
Repeat.

1623-2125-4740.description:
Cast Temporal Extortion by paying {B}{B}{B}{B}.
Temporal Extortion and Aetherflux Reservoir trigger.
Resolve the Aetherflux Reservoir trigger, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Resolve the Temporal Extortion trigger, causing you to pay half your life total, rounded up, and then exile Temporal Extortion and cast it without paying its mana cost due to Guile.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite life, you may activate Aetherflux Reservoir infinite times to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

628-2505-4279.notablePrerequisites:
Thragtusk does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is at least 2.
628-2505-4279.description:
Activate Yawgmoth's first ability by paying 1 life and sacrificing Thragtusk.
Thragtusk dies, triggering its second ability and its undying ability.
Resolve the first Thragtusk trigger, creating a 3/3 Beast creature token.
Resolve the second Thragtusk trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Thragtusk enters the battlefield, causing you to gain five life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability from step 1, putting a -1/-1 counter on a creature and causing you to draw a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the Beast token, putting a -1/-1 counter on Thragtusk and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

1247-4315.notablePrerequisites:
Careful Cultivation attached to Pili-Pala.
Pili-Pala does not have summoning sickness.
1247-4315.description:
Activate Pili-Pala by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Pili-Pala by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

323-2018-4050-5197.description:
Activate Downdraft by paying {G}, causing Luminous Broodmoth to lose flying until end of turn.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Luminous Broodmoth, adding {G}.
Falkenrath Noble triggers, causing a player to lose 1 life and causing you to gain 1 life.
Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Repeat.
